t: 在法国,里昂第二理事会开幕;它批准了一项法令来规范教皇的选举.
te: In France, the Second Council of Lyon opens; it ratified a decree to regulate the election of the Pope.
dz: 在法国,里昂第二理事会开幕;它批准了一项法令来规范教皇的选举.
de: In France, the Second Council of Lyon opens; it ratified a decree to regulate the election of the Pope.

t: 英国爱德华一世从第九次十字军东征中归来，并在十七天后加冕为国王。
te: Edward I of England returns from the Ninth Crusade and is crowned King seventeen days later.
dz: 英国爱德华一世从第九次十字军东征中归来，并在十七天后加冕为国王。
de: Edward I of England returns from the Ninth Crusade and is crowned King seventeen days later.

t: 英国爱德华一世的加冕典礼。
te: Coronation of Edward I of England.
dz: 英国爱德华一世的加冕典礼。
